messages.content: You are an expert programmer and mathematician.

Problem: A 10-by-12-inch page has margins of 1.5 inches on all sides. What fraction of the area of the page is taken up by the margins? Express your answer as a common fraction.

Solve step by step. End with: The answer is [your answer].

message.reasoning_content: We need answer. Need solve. Need be careful. Problem: 10 by 12 page, margins 1.5 all sides. Need fraction area taken up by margins. Page area = 120. Printable area? If margins all sides 1.5, inner rectangle dimensions (10 - 3) by (12 - 3) = 7 by 9 = 63. Margins area = 120 - 63 = 57. Fraction = 57/120 = simplify divide 3 = 19/40. Check orientation irrelevant. Answer 19/40. Need step-by-step concise. End exact phrase.
message.content:
The page area is:

\[
10 \times 12 = 120
\]

The margins are 1.5 inches on all sides, so the printed area is reduced by 3 inches in each dimension:

\[
(10-3) \times (12-3) = 7 \times 9 = 63
\]

So the margin area is:

\[
120 - 63 = 57
\]

The fraction of the page taken up by margins is:

\[
\frac{57}{120} = \frac{19}{40}
\]

The answer is \(\frac{19}{40}\).
